primary_query: Can we patent an enhanced bioavailability nano-liposomal formulation of Curcumin and Ashwagandha for osteoarthritic knee pain?
national_patent_verdict: PATENTABLE (Under Sec 2(1)(j) & Sec 3(d) proviso): Novel nanoliposomal delivery demonstrating 14x bioavailability and non-obvious synergistic anti-inflammatory index exceeding classical combination; NOT barred by Sec 3(p) TK bar since carrier delivery matrix is synthetic liposomal.
abs_compliance_obligation: MANDATORY: Must execute Form I Approval with National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) under Biological Diversity Act 2002 (amended 2023) prior to patent grant.
international_guidance: PCT International Application eligible; Mandatory disclosure of Indian biological origin required under WIPO GRATK Treaty (2024); US FDA Botanical Drug Guidance IND Phase I/II required for US marketing.
statutory_citations: Patents Act 1970 Sec 2(1)(j), 3(d), 3(p); Biological Diversity Act 2023 Sec 6; WIPO Treaty on Genetic Resources & TK Art 3 (2024)

primary_query: Can we claim patent exclusivity over an optimized vacuum-evaporated classical Chyawanprash method for export to the European Union?
national_patent_verdict: NON-PATENTABLE (Section 3(p) Traditional Knowledge Bar): Classical recipe described in Charaka Samhita, Chikitsa Sthana. Opposed via CSIR-TKDL prior art accession #TKDL-AM01/1429; Generic State Licensing Authority (SLA) manufacturing license applies.
abs_compliance_obligation: EXEMPT for domestic AYUSH practitioners; Benefit-Sharing intimation to Uttarakhand SBB required for commercial export consignments.
international_guidance: Cannot patent recipe abroad; Protectable via Registered Trademark (Class 5) + Geographical Indication (GI) tag; EU market access via Traditional Herbal Medicinal Products Directive (THMPD 2004/24/EC) 30-year medicinal use proof.
statutory_citations: Indian Patents Act Sec 3(p); Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940 First Schedule; EU Directive 2004/24/EC Art 16a; TKDL Archive TKDL-AM01/1429

primary_query: What are our legal rights and benefit-sharing royalties for licensing an indigenous anti-fatigue tonic to an Ayurvedic pharmaceutical firm?
formulation_tier: Patent & Proprietary Herb Extraction with Traditional Knowledge
national_patent_verdict: Kani Tribe Model Landmark: Extract method patentable by institute jointly with tribal trust; 50% license fees and 2% ongoing sales royalty statutory entitlement under ABS.
abs_compliance_obligation: CRITICAL: Access & Benefit Sharing (ABS) agreement between Kerala State Biodiversity Board (KSBB), TBGRI, and Tribal Trust under Biological Diversity Act 2023.
international_guidance: Protected against international patent piracy under Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) Nagoya Protocol Article 5.
statutory_citations: Biological Diversity Act 2023 Sec 21 (Fair & Equitable Benefit Sharing); Nagoya Protocol Art 5; Patents Act 1970 Sec 10(4)(ii)(D) mandatory source disclosure
